title: ShadowServe: Interference-Free KV Cache Fetching for Distributed Prefix Caching
authors: Xingyu Xiang; Raj Joshi; Yuhan Liu; Jiayi Yao; Chenxingyu Zhao; Junchen Jiang; Yang Zhou; Eddie Kohler; Minlan Yu
affiliations: Harvard University, University of Chicago, University of Washington, UC Davis

problem_statement.en: KV cache fetching in distributed prefix caching is bottlenecked by limited network bandwidth, and existing compression solutions cause significant interference with model computation when decompressed on the GPU.
problem_statement.zh: 分散式 prefix caching 中的 KV cache 抓取受限於有限的網路頻寬，而現有的壓縮方案在 GPU 上解壓縮時，會對模型計算造成顯著干擾。

key_innovation.en: ShadowServe, a SmartNIC-accelerated system that offloads KV cache fetching and decompression to the SmartNIC, using a chunked pipeline and minimal-copy memory management to eliminate host-side interference.
key_innovation.zh: ShadowServe 是一個以 SmartNIC 加速的系統，將 KV cache 的抓取與解壓縮卸載至 SmartNIC，藉由分塊流水線與最小化拷貝記憶體管理，徹底消除主機端的計算干擾。

key_improvements.en: Up to 2.2x lower loaded TPOT, up to 1.38x lower TTFT in low-bandwidth scenarios, and up to 1.35x higher throughput.
key_improvements.zh: 負載下 TPOT 最低降至原來的 1/2.2；低頻寬情境中 TTFT 最低降至原來的 1/1.38；throughput 最高提升 1.35x。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA L40S, Intel Xeon Gold 6526Y, 32GB DDR5 (on SmartNIC)
network_hw: NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPU, Mellanox ConnectX-7 400 Gbps NIC
